milestone.title: LiteLLM parity slice 7 — provider breadth (Anthropic + Google Gemini, chat + embeddings)
milestone.goal: a tenant calls Anthropic (chat) and Google Gemini (chat + embeddings) models through the same OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface, with native-API translation, billing, governance, and v8 routing intact

provider-chat-dispatch.title: make the chat completion path provider-aware: dispatch by served-model provider to a ChatTranslator adapter (OpenAI<->native, stream+non-stream, usage+errors); OpenRouter stays default byte-identical

anthropic-provider.title: Anthropic Messages API chat adapter: translate OpenAI chat <-> Anthropic /messages (request, response, SSE stream, usage, errors); register as provider='anthropic' chat adapter

gemini-provider.title: Google Gemini adapter: chat (generateContent + streamGenerateContent SSE) via the dispatch seam + embeddings (embedContent/batchEmbedContents) via the v7 UpstreamProvider seam; x-goog-api-key auth; OpenAI<->native translation

provider-breadth-live-verify.title: e2e double-pass through the TLS edge: Anthropic + Gemini chat (stream + non-stream) + Gemini embeddings via a single per-provider stub; billing on served id with correct usage; governance 401/402 intact; openrouter byte-identical
